resources.string: 1. Start the bike and open the dash screen-mirroring page (the one with the QR).
2. Turn on phone Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.
3. Just restarted the phone? Android Auto → ⋮ → Start head unit server.
Tip: keep the phone charging while riding. The first time, allow battery \"Unrestricted\".
Start the bike and open the dash screen-mirroring page (the one with the QR)
Phone Wi-Fi and Bluetooth ON (Bluetooth paired with the dash)
Just restarted the phone? Android Auto → ⋮ → Start head unit server
Scan the QR on the dash
Everything looks good. If it still won\'t connect, share the logs.
Found %1$d problem(s). Fix them from the top, then tap Re-check.
Android Auto is missing or is the 1.2 \"stub\". Update it from the Play Store.
After a phone restart: Android Auto → ⋮ → Stop head unit server → Start head unit server.
Turn Wi-Fi on. You don\'t need to join any network.
Pair the phone with the dash Bluetooth (ICANTRON_BT-… on the 368G). Turn off Bluetooth on any other phone that is holding the dash.
Otherwise the phone may kill the projection while you ride.
Lets the app resume by itself with the phone in your pocket.
If the switch is grey: tap ⋮ (top right) ▸ Allow restricted settings, then turn on Display over other apps.
No official dash app holding the connection
The Zontes / EasyConnection app grabs the same dash ports. Force stop it (or uninstall it).
Seen in the log. Clear Android Auto\'s storage (not \"uninstall updates\"), then turn on developer mode again: Wireless Android Auto + Unknown sources, and Start head unit server.
Bluetooth not paired with the dash (log)
The log shows no paired dash. Pair with ICANTRON_BT-… first.
Put the dash on its screen-mirroring page (the QR page). The dash only turns its Wi-Fi on there.
In use · tap to edit name and photo
Tap to add a photo of your bike

First time only
1. Android Auto settings → tap "Version" 10 times → ⋮ → Developer settings → allow unknown sources.
2. Pair the phone's Bluetooth with the dash (ICANTRON_BT…). Turn the iPhone's Bluetooth off if it was paired.
3. On the dash open screen mirroring, tap "Scan QR" in Settings → My bike, pick Zontes 368G.

Every ride
• Start the bike, open the mirroring page, tap Connect (or let it connect by itself when Bluetooth links).
• After a phone restart: Android Auto → ⋮ → "Start head unit server".
• Switching to another dash page (tyre pressure etc.) pauses the picture; come back and it returns.

Something wrong? Tap 🩺 App doctor.
✅ First-time setup is done · tap to show

For technicians. Connect to the bike\'s Wi‑Fi first (start the bike, open the mirroring page).\n\nThis only LOOKS: it lists which services the dash runs on its Wi‑Fi. It sends no files and changes nothing on the dash. Takes 1–3 minutes, then share the log.
No open ports found. Is the phone on the bike\'s Wi‑Fi?
⏳ Not yet: tap the button below
👉 The phone can\'t check this one: do it, then tap \"Done, next\"

Maps, music and calls from your phone, on the Zontes 368G dash.

Setup takes about 5 minutes, once. Do it with the bike nearby: the last step scans the QR on the dash.

Pick your language:
The app uses Android Auto on your phone to draw the map on the dash.\n\nSome phones come with a tiny \"stub\" version that can\'t do this. Tap the button and press Update / Install in Play Store.
Open Android Auto in Play Store

The app needs:
• Camera: to scan the QR on the dash
• Location / Nearby devices: to join the bike's Wi‑Fi
• Notifications: to keep running while you ride

Tap the button and choose "Allow" for each one.
Phones like OPPO, realme and Xiaomi close apps in the background to save battery, and the dash goes black mid-ride.\n\nTap the button and choose \"Allow\" (Unrestricted).

Done once in Android Auto's own settings:

1. Scroll to the bottom, tap "Version" 10 times → OK
2. ⋮ (top right) → Developer settings → turn on "Unknown sources"
3. ⋮ → "Start head unit server"

⚠️ After every phone restart, do step 3 again (the home screen will remind you).

Turn the bike on. In the phone\'s Bluetooth settings pair with the dash, named ICANTRON_BT-… (or ZT…).\n\nIf an iPhone or another phone was paired with the bike, turn its Bluetooth off first. Don\'t pair \"PKE-…\" (that\'s the key).
6 · Scan the QR on the dash

On the dash open screen mirroring (the page with a QR code), then tap the button and point the camera at it. Pick \"Zontes 368G\" when asked.\n\nThat\'s it. Next time just start the bike and tap Connect, or let it connect by itself.
Android doesn\'t let apps see this. If the dash shows the map it\'s on; after a phone restart: Android Auto → ⋮ → Start head unit server.
Tap an item to mark it done or edit it.
Icon changed. The home screen can take a few seconds to update.
Getting today\'s price… tap for settings
Your fuel (shown first, used for alerts)
Tank size, litres (for the full-tank cost)
Alert at 18:00 when tomorrow\'s price changes
Couldn\'t get the price from Bangchak or PTT. Check the internet and try again.
%1$s goes UP %2$s ฿ at 05:00 tomorrow (→ %3$s ฿). Filling up today is cheaper.
%1$s goes DOWN %2$s ฿ at 05:00 tomorrow (→ %3$s ฿). Worth waiting if you can.
Show your music on the dash?
To show the song and skip tracks, Android needs \"notification access\" for MotoScreen. It only reads what\'s playing; nothing leaves the phone.
Couldn\'t switch the dash to the MotoScreen screen. Stop, then connect again.

Connect to the bike, stay on the dash\'s mirroring page, then press SET / MODE (short and long), or a Bluetooth remote / intercom button. Every signal that reaches the phone appears below. Nothing appears = that button only drives the bike\'s own screen.
Drag to move · tap to select · long-press for options
Data from the phone: GPS, weather, fuel price. Tyre pressure, RPM and fuel level are not sent by the bike.
Put every widget back to the original layout? You can undo.
Saved · the dash uses it next time
No MotoScreen theme in the clipboard
Theme loaded · tap Save to use it
A = automatic (follow the theme / app colour)
Warn above (number turns red, edge pulses)

• Drag a widget to move it. It snaps to a grid; a yellow line shows the centre.
• Tap to select, then Style / Colour / Size / Layer.
• Long-press a widget for every option.
• Ready-made: start from a full theme, then move anything.
• Panels and lines go behind; to move a panel, grab its edge.
• Save: if the dash is on, the bike updates at once.

Data comes from the phone: GPS speed, heading, altitude, trip, weather, fuel price. Tyre pressure, RPM, gear and fuel level are not sent to the phone by the bike.
